title: Saaremaa Opera Days open in the courtyard of Kuressaare Castle
desc: The 19th Saaremaa Opera Days begin in the Kuressaare Castle courtyard, running from July 18 to 25. This year's headliner is Italy's Livorno Goldoni Opera House, while Estonia's top soloists will appear in the first part of Richard Wagner's opera tetralogy "The Ring of the Nibelung", "Das Rheingold", staged jointly by Eesti Kontsert and the National Theatre Vanemuine.
